title: Docker Buildx Filesystem Entitlements Protection Mechanism Failure Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Docker Buildx. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the processing of bake definition files. The issue results from the failure to apply a protection mechanism. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
addtionnal_details:
Docker has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/docker/buildx/security/advisories/GHSA-gwr2-q96m-6682
timeline:
